ilCases.shape: same call/ret opcode sequence with different direct-call member operands keeps distinct body identities

same ldc.i4.s/ret opcode sequence with different numeric constant operands keeps distinct body identities

ilasmParityCases.shape: ordered Windows discovery pins Microsoft .NET Framework 4.8 ILAsm from the Framework/Framework64 v4.0.30319 runtime directories and Windows SDK NETFX ILDAsm by absolute path, records exact file versions and the runner image, and fails when either pinned 4.8.x tool is missing or not invocable
ilasmParityCases.expectedIdentity: pinned absolute tool paths with recorded 4.8.x file versions and runner identity
ilasmParityCases.prerequisites: ILAsm ships with the .NET Framework runtime under C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319 and the x86 C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework twin; ILDAsm ships with the Windows SDK NETFX 4.8/4.8.1 Tools (x64 first); both must report a 4.8.x file version

ilasmParityCases.shape: the public control-flow fixture assembly disassembles with the pinned ILDAsm, reassembles with the pinned ILAsm, and disassembles again to identical normalized IL text while TraceMap joins every method of the bound before/after pair as unchanged with instruction, local, max-stack, and call-offset counts equal to the ILDAsm observation on both sides
ilasmParityCases.expectedIdentity: unchanged il-rewrite edges for every method with tokenRetargeted=false and zero gaps

ilasmParityCases.shape: nested try regions, catch/fault handler kinds, leave targets, and the dense switch table of the public fixtures keep identical exception-clause structure across the independent round trip, with ILDAsm handler-clause counts equal to TraceMap exception-region counts on both sides
ilasmParityCases.expectedIdentity: unchanged il-rewrite edges whose exception-region digests are identical on both sides

ilasmParityCases.shape: the public member-shape fixture with generic method specifications, ldtoken type tokens, calli standalone signatures, static field operands, custom-modifier-bearing parameters, property and event accessors, and vararg declarations round trips through the pinned tools with every symbolic operand preserved verbatim in the canonical ILDAsm body; methods whose raw module-local reference tokens ILAsm renumbered on re-emission classify exactly operand-only-change with every call-retarget identity preserved
ilasmParityCases.expectedIdentity: unchanged or operand-only-change il-rewrite edges for every member-shape method with zero gaps and identity-preserving retargets
ilasmParityCases.limitations: raw module-local tokens are locations, not stable cross-build identities; renumbering alone is operand-only-change by contract

ilasmParityCases.shape: the public branch-retarget, handler-kind, and stack-neutral insertion mutations keep their exact TraceMap relationship classification when the mutated after side passes through ILDAsm and ILAsm before scanning, with identical normalized disassembly of the raw and round-tripped after sides
ilasmParityCases.expectedIdentity: operand-only-change, body-structure-change, and instruction-stream-change edges identical for the raw and round-tripped after sides

ilasmParityCases.shape: the non-hidden sequence points of an embedded portable PDB fixture observed independently as ILDAsm .line directives (the documented /linenum switch with the extracted PDB adjacent) equal TraceMap declared sequence points for IL offsets and line/column spans; an ILDAsm that accepts /linenum yet emits no .line directives records the typed oracle-availability gap with a precise work-machine reproduction command and expected receipt instead of claiming parity
ilasmParityCases.expectedIdentity: equal sorted (offset, startLine, endLine, startColumn, endColumn) tuples from both observers, or the recorded typed gap with no parity claim
ilasmParityCases.prerequisites: ILDAsm 4.8.3928.0 documents /LINENUM for source-line references and has no /pdbpath option; observed on the hosted win25-vs2026 runner on 2026-09-23, that ILDAsm accepted /linenum and disassembled the carrier but emitted no .line directives for the adjacent extracted portable PDB, leaving this case unclaimed pending a work-machine receipt
